extName.description: The extension's name in the browser and the Chrome Web Store

extDesc.message: Records the tab's console, errors and network next to a Znimok screen recording — to watch a bug together with what the page did.
extDesc.description: The store's summary: at most 132 characters

actionTitle.description: The toolbar button's tooltip when nothing is recorded

cmdToggle.message: Start or stop recording this window

tipRec.description: Toolbar tooltip while recording; {t} is the time

tipPaused.description: Toolbar tooltip while paused; {t} is the time

menuStart.description: Right-click menu of the icon: start a recording of this window

popupOff.description: Popup: the app is not found

popupBusy.description: Popup: while the window is looked for

popupPage.message: Page only — no tabs or address bar

hintOff.message: Start Znimok — the extension finds the app by itself.
hintOff.description: Popup hint when the app is not found

hintOn.message: While recording, clicking the extension icon stops it; pause is in the right-click menu.

hintLog.message: While the log is written, the browser shows the "extension is debugging this browser" bar — a page-only recording doesn't show it. The log writes what the Network panel shows (headers, request and response bodies); sensitive parts can be hidden on export.
hintLog.description: Popup hint when the log is on

whyNoApp.message: Znimok not found — start the app.

whyDisabled.message: Starting recording from the extension is turned off in Znimok (Settings → Recording).

whyBusy.message: A recording is already running or a region is being picked.

whyNotFound.message: Could not find this browser window.

whyAmbiguous.message: Several windows show the same tab — switch to another tab or start with Alt+Shift+5.

whyUnsupported.message: Recording from the extension on this system comes with the next update.

hintNoHost.message: Znimok is not set up for this browser. Update Znimok and start it — it registers itself.
hintNoHost.description: Popup hint when the browser has no native host manifest (ZK-300)
